title: ON TOP OF THE BURNT OFFERING

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'and Aaron's sons are to burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is lying on the burning wood; it is a food offering, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.'" - Lev 3:5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Notice where the fellowship offering is placed: on top of the burnt offering.

That is not a random instruction. The burnt offering of chapter 1 — the offering of atonement and total consecration — was already burning on the altar. The fellowship offering did not get its own fire. It rested on the one already lit.

The order matters. Atonement first. Fellowship second, built on top of it.

Many believers get this reversed. They try to generate closeness with God as a way of becoming acceptable to Him. They pray harder, serve more, feel more, hoping the fellowship will produce the standing. But Leviticus lays the foundation clearly: the sacrifice comes first, and everything else rests on it.

Your relationship with God does not sit on your spiritual performance. It sits on Christ's finished work. Hebrews says that by one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy (Heb 10:14) — perfect already, being made holy still. The foundation is settled while the growth continues.

If your fellowship with God feels shaky today, do not try to rebuild the foundation. Check what you are resting on. The fire is already burning.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I trying to earn closeness with God, or resting on what Christ has already done?
2. What am I building my sense of acceptance on this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that my fellowship with You rests on Christ's finished work and not my performance. Settle my heart on that foundation today. Amen.
